validity.recommendation: Keep the row. Fill the blank [ref] cells (Status/Start/Length/Diameter/Location) with the verified independent refs staged below; specs are solid.
validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE + CLASSIFICATION: unambiguously real and correctly a gas transmission trunk. IGAT 1 (خط لوله اول سراسری گاز ایران) is the FIRST Iranian Gas Trunkline, built 1965-1970 and inaugurated at Astara in October 1970 by Mohammad Reza Pahlavi and Soviet president Podgorny to export gas to the USSR/South Caucasus. GEM's row rested on a SINGLE citation (offshore-technology.com marketdata aggregator, the same page it already cites) — an existence-support thinness — but independent corroboration is overwhelming: Encyclopaedia Iranica (natural-gas-industry-in-iran), English Wikipedia (Iran_Gas_Trunkline), Persian Wikipedia, and IMEG (the British consulting firm that designed/supervised the first 600 km Bid Boland->Saveh segment) all describe the same physical line. SPEC agreement across independent sources: diameter 42 in (WP 42 in/1070 mm; GulfPub 'IGAT 1' 42.0; offshore-tech 'max 42 in' — AGREE with GEM 42), length ~1104 km (offshore-tech 1,104 km; WP 1,104 km; fa.WP first-phase ~1120 km — AGREE with GEM 1104.00), start year 1970 (Oct 1970 completion — AGREE with GEM StartYear1=1970), endpoints Bid Boland Gas Refinery, Khuzestan -> Astara, Gilan (WP + offshore-tech: 'starts Khuzestan, ends Gilan' — AGREE with GEM Start=Khuzestan/End=Gilan). Fuel=Gas confirmed. Nothing on existence/classification/spec is wrong. Two lesser issues raised as separate validity entries below (owner attribution; possible corridor overlap with P0748).

validity.recommendation: Change Owner1/Operator from 'National Iranian Oil Co' (NIOC) to 'National Iranian Gas Co' (NIGC) — GEM's OWN cited source contradicts the current value. Verify against NIGC/IGTC before applying.
validity.researcher_notes: GEM has Owner1 = National Iranian Oil Co (NIOC) 100%. But the row's own cited source (offshore-technology marketdata) states the line is 'operated by National Iranian Gas', and English Wikipedia states operator = National Iranian Gas Company (NIGC). Iran's gas trunklines are owned/operated by NIGC and its subsidiary the Iranian Gas Transmission Company (IGTC), not the oil parent NIOC. Counterpoint: the independent GulfPub PE World Map lists NIOC as operator for essentially ALL Iranian gas lines (a known GulfPub systematic default, not line-specific). Net: current NIOC value is contradicted by 2 sources (incl. GEM's own) and only 'supported' by a source that blanket-assigns NIOC. Recommend correcting to NIGC.

validity.recommendation: Human de-dup review vs P0748 (Hajiqabul-Astara-Abadan Gas Pipeline). Likely the same physical Iran-side trunkline corridor modeled twice at different lengths; confirm before any merge — do NOT auto-merge.
validity.researcher_notes: POSSIBLE OVERLAP with roster row P0748 'Hajiqabul-Astara-Abadan Gas Pipeline' (Gazimammad, Azerbaijan -> Khuzestan, Iran; len 1474.5 km; dia 1020/1200 mm ~40/47 in; cap 10 bcm). IGAT 1 runs Bid Boland (Khuzestan) -> Astara (Gilan, on the Azerbaijan border); Persian Wikipedia notes the historical line continued past Astara to Haji-Qabul in Azerbaijan to deliver gas to the USSR. P0748 is that SAME Astara-Khuzestan corridor plus the Azerbaijan continuation (Astara-Hajigabul/Gazimammad), so the ~1474 km = the ~1104 km Iranian IGAT-1 trunk + the Azerbaijani section. English Wikipedia, however, terminates IGAT 1 at Astara and does not extend it into Azerbaijan, so this may instead be a deliberate binational-vs-Iranian-only distinction rather than a true duplicate. Diameters differ slightly (42 vs 40/47 in). Flagging as a lead for a human de-dup decision, NOT asserting a merge. If P0748 is the modern Iran-Azerbaijan swap arrangement it is distinct; if it is the legacy IGAT-1 export corridor it double-counts P3957.

routes.start_name: Bid Boland Gas Refinery, Behbahan area, Khuzestan Province, Iran
routes.end_name: Astara, Gilan Province, Iran (Caspian coast, on the Azerbaijan border)

waypoints.name: Saveh, Markazi Province (end of the original 600 km first segment)

routes.corridor_desc: Runs SSW-to-N across Iran: from the Bid Boland Gas Refinery in southern Khuzestan (fed by the Marun/Aghajari/Ahvaz fields) northward up the Zagros foothills, the first ~600 km 42-in segment reaching Saveh near Tehran (Markazi), then continuing north through Qazvin and up to Astara on the Caspian coast at the Azerbaijan border. Endpoints are firmly named (Bid Boland, Astara); the intermediate corridor is bounded at city level (Saveh, Qazvin) rather than surveyed centerline, so the mid-line geometry is a medium-tight bound.
routes.researcher_notes: Current sheet endpoints are placeholders ('Asia'->'Asia'); real endpoints established as Bid Boland Gas Refinery (Khuzestan) -> Astara (Gilan). WP gives both endpoints; IMEG (British firm that engineered the Bid Boland->Saveh first segment) confirms the southern origin and the Saveh waypoint. Coordinates are real place coordinates for named cities/facilities (Astara 38.43N/48.87E and Saveh/Qazvin are well-known settlements; Bid Boland refinery ~30.43N/49.80E near Behbahan) — none fabricated. Endpoints support keeping RouteAccuracy=high; intermediate geometry only city-level.

summary: P3957 IGAT 1 is real, correctly classed as a 42-in gas transmission trunk (Bid Boland/Khuzestan -> Astara/Gilan, ~1104 km, opened Oct 1970); specs corroborated by 2+ independent sources. Concerns: owner should be NIGC not NIOC (GEM's own source contradicts it) and a possible corridor overlap with P0748.
